memory_candidates.content: When a plan's own Risk table cites a specific broken-link pattern (e.g. '../README.md from docs/guides/') as an example of what NOT to introduce, read that as scoping the plan's relative-link verification obligation to links the task itself inserts or modifies -- not an instruction to forensically audit every pre-existing link in a touched file. A full-file link sweep still surfaces pre-existing defects worth logging (issue-record.sh), but fixing them is typically out of scope unless the plan names them.

verify-deploy.sh's --only-gate flag is capped at 1-23 even though a gate24 block exists in the source (lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh); use tests/run-all.sh --only <test-basename>.sh instead to scope-discharge a gate above that range under a Batch Gate Deferral directive.
